recognize_zh: 視野中央一個大型前紅血球母細胞，體積約為旁邊嗜中性球的兩倍，細胞質是一圈深藍色、核圓且染色質細緻淡染；在 Parvovirus 感染的情境下，這種巨大前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast）是典型線索，但此圖解析度下看不到明確的核內包涵體。
features: Giant pronormoblast roughly twice the diameter of the adjacent neutrophil
Round nucleus with finely granular, pale chromatin filling most of the cell; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Narrow rim of intensely basophilic, deep-blue agranular cytoplasm
Adjacent band/segmented neutrophil with normal granulation for size comparison
Background red cells normocytic with scattered platelets; discrete intranuclear inclusion not resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged pronormoblast, approximately twice the size of an adjacent neutrophil, with a round nucleus containing finely dispersed pale chromatin and a narrow rim of intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm. A distinct viral intranuclear inclusion or cytoplasmic vacuolation is not clearly resolved at this magnification, and the surrounding field lacks maturing erythroid precursors. In the clinical context, findings are consistent with a giant pronormoblast of parvovirus B19 infection; correlation with reticulocytopenia and parvovirus PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less basophilic cytoplasm, visible nucleoli and may contain granules or Auer rods, and are CD34/MPO positive rather than E-cadherin/CD71 positive.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with cytoplasmic vacuoles and dysplasia, whereas parvovirus giant pronormoblasts are isolated in an otherwise erythroid-depleted marrow.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and a prominent central nucleolus, and are CD138 positive.
